title: Swamp–Mud–Debt State Machine
purpose: Give the Swamp/Mud/Karma branch a precise process model: distinguish residue, environment, obligation, compression and exit rather than treating all lower-world terms as synonyms.
epistemic_rule: This is Potatoverse/project systems vocabulary. Real-world allegations, debts, liabilities and harms remain case-specific and evidence-bound.

canonical_distinctions.Mud: residue: a trace left by conflict, harm, accusation, humiliation, misinformation, unresolved memory or other relational disturbance
canonical_distinctions.Swamp: environment: accumulated unresolved residue whose interactions begin shaping behavior, roles, incentives and future interpretation
canonical_distinctions.Debt: obligation: the portion of unresolved consequence attributed to a relation and judged to require truth, correction, restitution, repair, changed conduct or release
canonical_distinctions.Mountain: compression/integration: many weighted traces and obligations made visible as one structured burden or perspective field
canonical_distinctions.Drain: low-attractor/outflow: collapse of unresolved loops toward reduced agency or repeated loss of footing
canonical_distinctions.Forge: pressure-processing field: accumulated material can be transformed into usable capacity or weaponized identity
canonical_distinctions.Door: regime transition: a relation can cross from repetition/entanglement into a changed state
canonical_distinctions.Garden: post-repair generativity: a condition where restored relations support future autonomous growth

primary_paths.stagnation: event -> trace -> Mud -> accumulation -> Swamp -> recurrence -> more Mud
primary_paths.obligation: event -> trace -> attribution -> unresolved responsibility -> Debt -> delay/denial -> compounding
primary_paths.compression: many traces + many obligations + duration -> Mountain
primary_paths.early_repair: Mud -> context/provenance -> correction/repair -> Soil -> Root -> renewed growth
primary_paths.late_repair: Swamp/Debt -> sorting -> Mountain/perspective -> Door -> repair/release -> Garden
primary_paths.pressure_transformation: burden/heat -> compression -> {Swamp stagnation | Forge transformation | Needle threshold} -> changed structure

non_equivalence_rules: Mud is not automatically Debt: a trace may be false, trivial, resolved or wrongly attributed.
Debt is not automatically Swamp: a clear specific obligation can exist without systemic entanglement.
Swamp is not automatically Mountain: Swamp mixes unresolved material; Mountain integrates differentiated material.
Mountain is not inherently good: compressed burden can become domination, rigidity or judgment without service.
Mud is not inherently evil: processed residue can become Soil.
Repair does not require every conflict to escalate into a Mountain first.
core_relational_law: Resolve residue before it becomes structure.

mountain_swamp_duality.shared_input: many traces, memories, pressures and relations
mountain_swamp_duality.short_form: Swamp stores complexity badly; Mountain stores complexity coherently.
mountain_swamp_duality.caution: This is archive synthesis, not an objective law of psychology or society.

hydrological_crosswalk.status: high-value structural analogy; not literal cosmology
hydrological_crosswalk.Swamp: stagnant or slow overlapping flows with accumulated sediment
hydrological_crosswalk.Mountain: watershed/high ground giving direction and separation to flows
hydrological_crosswalk.Garden: life produced when flow, boundary and nourishment are well ordered
hydrological_crosswalk.ledger_relation: The ledger records where consequences came from, where they moved, where they became stuck, who remains connected, and what repair changes the flow.

information_crosswalk.Swamp: dense archive where old narratives bias interpretation of new material
information_crosswalk.Debt: future interpretive/repair obligation created by unresolved or harmful information
information_crosswalk.Mountain: sourced synthesis that preserves distinctions while integrating many records
information_crosswalk.Door: correction, adjudication, reframing or release that changes the relation
information_crosswalk.Garden: usable knowledge that increases agency rather than fixation

temporal_crosswalk.Debt: a past relation that still places a claim on future action

repair_priority.principle: Earlier repair is cheaper than late-stage systemic reckoning.
repair_priority.sequence: trace -> verify -> contextualize -> correct -> repair -> release
repair_priority.anti_pattern: allow trace -> archive -> repetition -> identity lock-in -> Swamp -> institutional entanglement -> Mountain-scale burden
repair_priority.project_maxim_candidate: Drain the Swamp before it becomes a Mountain of debt.
repair_priority.formal_restraint: Treat the maxim as archive synthesis unless recovered as Tim's exact wording.
